subject.title: feat: Discord channel-per-agent binding display in Gateway UI (ZZ-20260311-005)

question: Should OpenClaw add a generic read-only `routing.list` Gateway RPC and an Agents tab channel-bindings card for per-agent Discord bindings, or keep binding visibility in existing config/CLI/docs surfaces?
rationale: The request improves operator visibility for an existing binding model, but it adds new core Gateway protocol and Control UI surface rather than fixing a defined bug.

options.title: Accept generic routing visibility
options.body: Refresh or replace the linked implementation so current main exposes a read-only routing summary and selected-agent binding display with focused API/UI tests.

options.title: Keep existing surfaces
options.body: Decline the new Gateway/UI surface and continue relying on config, docs, and CLI inspection for binding visibility.

options.title: Defer API shape
options.body: Keep this issue open as a design item until maintainers settle whether the contract should be Discord-specific, channel-generic, or config-summary-oriented.

recommendation.title: Accept generic routing visibility
recommendation.body: Refresh or replace the linked implementation so current main exposes a read-only routing summary and selected-agent binding display with focused API/UI tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has recent routing feature/refactor history in the binding area and is the clearest product/API decision owner from the inspected commits.
